name: Physical Deflection Angle Mapping
description: Replaces the algebraic formula $I(v)$ and the sum inequality with a physical model of test rays and deflection angles ($0^\circ$ or $90^\circ$). The sum of angles being strictly less than $180^\circ$ logically enforces that at least one ray must not be deflected, exactly preserving the 2-SAT OR-clause structure while completely hiding the standard boolean satisfiability framing from pattern-matching models.
